dialog2dText.cn:
阿莱克琉斯留下的超域烙印不断与源石力量互斥。这种几无停息的冲突让管理员十分痛苦。即使佩丽卡从M3处知晓此事后已尝试过对管理员进行治疗，但常规的治疗手段收效甚微，或许只有借助巨兽代理人祀的力量，才能消除超域对管理员的影响。
祀已暂时缓解了管理员的病症，并提前回去准备疗伤之法。庄方宜则在知晓此事后迅速批复了管理员往来所需的文件并抵达帝江号看望。如今，在做好一切准备之后，管理员便可随时启程前往为其安排的疗养地。
dialog2dText.en:
M3 has informed Perlica that the Æther burns inflicted by Alleikhreos are reacting against the Endministrator's Originium powers and causing an Æther sickness. Perlica has tried to treat it, but the effects are limited. Feranmut Proxy Si might be the only one with the power to cure the Endministrator.
Si has temporarily alleviated the Endministrator's sickness and is heading back early to prepare a treatment. Zhuang Fangyi has quickly approved the Endministrator's paperwork and personally shows up at Dijiang for a visit. Everything is ready for the Endministrator to visit Si and receive treatment.

dialog2dText.cn: 水果和糕点在窗边的桌子上堆成了小山，刚沏好的茶水放在一边。这究竟是祀专门为你准备的，还是客栈按惯例给入住客人的见面礼？你看着面前足够喂饱一头驮兽的食物，有点不知所措。
dialog2dText.en: The table next to the window has a pile of fruits and desserts as well as freshly brewed tea. Is this VIP treatment from Si? Or standard fare for every guest staying at the inn? The quantity is quite shocking. There is enough to feed a hungry burdenbeast.

dialog2dText.cn: 既来之则安之，在短暂的错愕后，你拿起食物开始品尝。不得不说，祀准备的糕点非常美味，即使放置许久，也如同刚刚出炉一般带着温热与麦香。水果似乎是采摘下来经过清洗后刚刚放入篮中的，一口下去，汁水充足，酸甜在口腔中肆意扩散。若是吃乏了，吃干了，一杯茶水下肚，茶香顺着口腔滑入食道，便能把口中的干噎与酸涩一扫而空。于是你吃了很久，很久——直到发现糕点与水果一点也没少，壶中的茶水也饮之不尽，吃喝许久却只饱而不腹胀时，你才意识到眼前这小食桌是祀动用权能制作，专门用来满足口腹之欲的。
dialog2dText.en: Always look on the bright side of life. You quickly recover from the surprise and taste the desserts prepared by Si. They are very delicious, with the warmth and fragrance of a nice oven. The fruits in the basket offer juicy bursts of tanginess and sweetness that tease your palate. The tea perfectly complements the snack and cleanses the throat for another round. After spending quite a while eating and drinking away, you notice that the pile of food remains just as large, the teapot just as full, and your belly just as empty. Finally, you realize that the snacks have been made with Si's powers to sate the curious palate.

dialog2dText.cn:
看着眼前这堆吃食，一大堆问题浮上了你的心头。
“原来从前的我是那么能吃的人吗？一顿餐间小食都要吃那么多，那到了正餐，真要吃上十二三碟珍馐才能满足？”
“既然这是祀的画，那画里的食物会不会只是墨水？我要是闭上眼，没了视觉，是不是眼前的东西就只有墨味了？”
“这茶壶好像能够无限倾倒出茶水，究竟是怎么做到的？这茶壶下也没接水桶，难道这就是巨兽权能的神通吗？”
…………
各种各样的问题在你脑中冲撞，以至于回过神来时，已经过了许久——
话虽如此，窗外的天色并没有一丝一毫的变化。这样一来，刚刚没想通的疑问，便又加了一条。
dialog2dText.en:
You look at the pile of food and many questions arise.
"Have I been someone with a huge appetite? If I'm getting this much for snacks, a typical meal should have at least twelve or so choice dishes."
"Wait. This is Si's painting. Maybe the snacks are made with ink. If I were to close my eyes to the visual effects, will they taste of ink?"
"This teapot seems endless, but it's not connected to any fluid tank. How did she do it? Is this the Arts of Feranmut powers?"
......
All sorts of questions fly about your mind, and quite a while has passed when you finally decide to stop obsessing about things.
Nevertheless, the sky outside the window has barely changed, adding yet another puzzle to the many questions you already have.

dialog2dText.cn: 书架上塞满了书籍，仔细一看，这书架似乎还有机关，摁下书架上的各种符号后，书架便会运作起来，更换上其他藏书。或许祀真的能在一定程度上控制这里的时间，不然你很难想象，自己与祀在画卷中相处时，竟收集并阅读了这么多的书籍。你决定挑上一本，看看从前的自己究竟将怎样的书籍塞入了收藏。
dialog2dText.en: This seems to be an auto-bookshelf filled with books. Pressing various buttons lets the shelf display new collections. Perhaps Si does control the flow of time in this place, allowing the past you to gather quite a library. You decide to pick a book and gauge the reading preferences of your past self.

dialog2dText.cn: 这本书介绍了炎国历史上各种与断案相关的传奇故事。像是有着“四场血案四个时代，三个孩童三条线索，两大家族两个派系，一个时间一个主谋，没有后续没有结果”之判词，延宕数十载，牵扯朝堂上下千万人，影响国祚的复合式要案；又或是一位曾升堂断案的巨兽代理人，面对犯人缜密的脱罪证据时，口含天宪，一锤定音，以雷霆手段伸张正义的故事；还有大炎初成，法律初定时那些游走于道德、民俗、情感与真相间的桩桩件件——有些故事似乎偏离了书本的主旨，但其中的内容大多易读且精彩。这本书还留有最近被翻折过的痕迹，看来祀不久前刚看过。
dialog2dText.en: A collection of mythical court cases in Yanese history. One is a complex high-profile case that threatened the very fabric of the Yan nation. It spanned decades and involved tens of thousands of Imperial Court officials "Four murders for each of the four ages. Three children with three leads. Two dynasties and two factions. One timeline and one culprit. Zero further reports, and zero conclusions." Another case involved a Feranmut Proxy who once served as a judge, facing a suspect who gave a seemingly perfect defense. But the judge cited the imperial constitution, hammered his verdict, and achieved justice like a bolt of lightning. There are other cases that took place when both Great Yan and her Laws were young, where truth was weighed against public morality, traditions, and personal relationships. Some stories deviated from the main theme of the book, though they are easy to read and very engaging. You notice flip marks and folds on the book. Si probably read it recently.

dialog2dText.cn: 这本书讲述了移动城市在泰拉的起源和到塔卫二后的因地制宜，最终提及我们如今最为神秘的移动城市——塞什卡。在泰拉时代，建立移动城市的初衷，是为了躲避源石引发的天灾，集中人口与产业，并确立国家的边界。移动城市技术在经过发展后，也衍生出了各种变体，其中最经典的就是高速战舰。在进入塔卫二后，由于没有了天灾袭扰，人们更倾向于在固定区域聚居，移动城市技术也就此翻开了新的篇章。如今，各个阵营都仍保有一定数量的舰船，但几乎不再建造移动城市级别的舰船了。作为移动城市，塞什卡的特殊之处在于其是一座飞行都市，由于其技术几乎没有复刻的可能性，这也让这座萨卡兹的城市一直笼罩在神秘的面纱之中——在阅读的时候，你看到了书中的各种记号，毫无疑问，这是曾经的你留下的笔记，只是，有些记号的作用，你还没回想起来。
dialog2dText.en: This book describes the origins of nomadic cities in Terra, the adaptations after the Terrans arrived at Talos-II, and finally mentions Seš'qa, the most mysterious nomadic city in existence. During the Age of Terra, nomadic cities were mainly built to provide platforms capable of accommodating large populations and industries, establishing presences in national borders, while avoiding Originium Catastrophes. Continuous development of nomadic city technology also made other variants possible, an example being the high-speed battleship. Given the absence of Catastrophes on Talos-II, most people chose to live in permanent cities instead and ushered in a new age of nomadic city technology. Though every faction maintains a sizable fleet of landships, hardly any additional city-scale ships have been built. As a nomadic city, Seš'qa is unique since it is also a flying city, made possible with essentially irreproducible technology. These add to the mysteries of this Sarkazian city. While reading, you notice various markings in the book. The past you must have left them, but the current you fail to recall what they meant.

dialog2dText.cn: 这是一本风格轻快，行文简练的书。其收录了塔卫二上各个物种的前世今生：有塔卫二原生物种，有从泰拉带来的物种，也有杂交或变异后出现的新物种。每个物种都配有精美的插图，而问答则以最直白的语言解答人们的各种疑惑。在这本书中，能看到像是驮兽、荞花、吐虫长股兽这种常常出现在身边的动植物，也有许多稀有的，甚至是未从泰拉来到塔卫二，仅存在于记录中的动植物——这明显是一本面向青少年，百科全书类的科普读物。虽然细节你记不太清了，但仍能感觉到，其中的一些结论与发现，一定出自于你本人。如果没有天使战争，没有泰拉人与基石的恩仇，或许你现在就正在编写这样的书籍，而不是在战争中一次次失去，一次次痛苦。
dialog2dText.en: An approachable book with relatively easy text. The book lists the background and current statuses of various lifeforms on Talos-II, including indigenous species, those brought from Terra, as well as novel hybrids and mutant variants of the previous two. The page for every species is furnished with beautiful illustrations. The Q&A sections give easy-to-understand answers to commonly asked questions. Species include everyday lifeforms such as burdenbeasts, buckflowers, and bugspitting lankybeasts, as well as rare organisms that only exist in records as the Terrans did not bring them to Talos-II. The book is obviously a work of general education for young readers. Though you cannot recall any details, part of you senses that some of the conclusions and discoveries were made by your past self. If the Aggeloi War never broke out ... if there was no hatred between the Terrans and the Foundation, you might be working on a similar book right now, instead of losing pieces of yourself and taking on bouts of pain and suffering with every conflict.

dialog2dText.cn:
你知道很多装饰品都没什么用意，仅仅只是出于美观，或者，装潢时“那里必须有些什么！”的灵机一动。可要是东西是放在床头的，那就说不准了，毕竟很少有东西会特意安放在床头上方的空间。你看着这幅奇怪的挂画，上面只有几笔飘逸的水墨，看不出到底画的是什么，唯一能够肯定的是，它是祀的手笔。
你看着那静止却似乎正在流动的水墨，忽然想起萨米维格有一种叫作捕梦网的东西，如同护身符一般，它似乎有着保护睡梦中的人们免遭噩梦侵扰的能力，你不禁怀疑，这幅画卷，本身也是类似的东西。等等，难道说？！
你凝望着画卷，试图从水墨里瞧出些什么。如果你的直觉没错，那么，这些水墨很有可能是你在这里安眠的无数个日夜中睡梦的形状。如果你想知道里面潜藏的秘密，向祀寻求答案当然是最简便的方式。又或者，在画卷下方的床榻上休息一晚，是不是也能循着梦的痕迹，行入画卷之中，进入由你自己描绘的天地？
dialog2dText.en:
You know most ornamentals are purely for aesthetics, or for a sudden need to "fill that place up with a doodad". But bedside objects are usually there for a distinct purpose. You study the strange composition with only a few random lines of ink. You do not know what is being drawn, but you are certain this is Si's work.
The lines of ink are serene yet seem to flow. You suddenly remember the dreamcatchers of Samivegr that protect people in their sleep against disturbing nightmares. You wonder if the painting does the same thing. Hold on. You are suddenly onto something!
As you gaze at the painting and try to make something out of the ink, you consider: If your intuition is correct, the ink patterns might be the shape of your dreams, molded by the many nights you have slept here. Asking Si might be the easiest way to learn about its secrets. Perhaps spending a night on the bed beneath the painting can let you follow the dream trails, enter the scroll, and create your own painted realm.

dialog2dText.cn:
这幅画描绘了尚未戴上抑制器时你的模样。画中，你似乎正因获得了一块闪闪发光的源石而感到高兴。你依稀回想起来，除了缘缘庄里看到的，和阿达希尔被囚禁时祀所展现的那一幅，她曾经还和你分享过许多这样的画像——有她哥哥姐姐的，有宏科院天师的，有终末地干员的，还有更多一时兴起画下的普通人的。祀当然能画更艺术、更优雅的画，山川水墨，工笔人像，将细节刻画到极致，借着巨兽的权能，甚至能比实物更加鲜活。
但她最喜欢的，还是这些简单的画，以及那些画背后稍纵即逝的回忆。“最深刻的记忆，就应当用最简单的方式记录。”她当时是这么说。
至于为什么阿达希尔会被画成那样——
“你难道看得不开心吗？”祀用一句话给堵了回去。
dialog2dText.en:
An illustration of you without your suppressor mask. The painting depicts you happily discovering a piece of shining Originium. In addition to the works at Yuanyuan Manor, you faintly remember the paintings of Ardashir and of many others that Si has shown you — her elder siblings, Tianshi of Hongshan, Endfield operators, and even ordinary people when Si felt that urge to paint. She is fully capable of creating beautiful, elegant illustrations with extreme levels of detail, from breathtaking landscapes to depictions of people. In fact, her Feranmut power makes her work even more lifelike than the original objects.
But her favorite works remain these simple depictions, and fleeting moments of memories linked to them. "The deepest memories should be recorded in the simplest way," she once said.
As for the unique approach to Ardashir's depiction —
"Does looking at it make you unhappy?" Si shot the discussion down with a single line.

dialog2dText.cn:
经过你的努力，Delta型机器人如同终于睡醒了一般，恢复了运行。
但它的样子和其他机器人截然不同，没有多余的动作，也没有投影新的表情，让你几乎要怀疑自己是否真的修好了它。
而为了探寻这些Delta型机器人身上的秘密，你决定……
dialog2dText.en:
You finish the repairs and the Delta Bot behaves as though it has ended its sleep session and reverts to its work routines. 
This unit looks different compared to the others. It does not perform additional actions or project any emotes. In fact, you now doubt if you have truly fixed the robot. 
To investigate the secrets of the Delta Bots, you decide to...

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近七年的机器人，主要从事短途运输工作。
除了数不尽的指令数据，只剩一条路线数据。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly seven years, and mainly carried out short-distance delivery jobs.
Within an endless number of command entries, only one entry appears to be route data.

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人从开始运行到出现在这里前，所有工作都是在同一条路线上来回完成的，搬运的物资也完全一样。
这种程度的重复性工作即使在众多Delta型机器人中也相当罕见。
日志末尾有一些意义不明的字词组合：结束 结束 休息 梦 重复 重复 重复
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, this unit has performed all its jobs, since it became operational till its final rest here, along the same route, and carrying the same goods. 
Such extreme repetition is quite rare, even amongst the numerous Delta Bots in service. 
The log ends with a mysterious text string: "End. End. Rest. Dream. Repeat. Repeat. Repeat."

dialog2dText.cn: 你隐约觉得Delta型机器人的诡异行动应该和数据与日志里的记录有关，但想要进一步探究，显然还需要更多线索。
dialog2dText.en: You are starting to see a link between the Delta Bot's abnormal behavior and its data logs. However, you obviously need more intel to further your investigation.

dialog2dText.cn:
经过你的努力，Delta型机器人终于颤颤巍巍地动了起来，它似乎有些搞不清状况，投影了一个疑惑的表情。
随后，面对那些机器人的残骸，它只是默默地站在一旁，像是在回忆什么。
而为了探寻这些Delta型机器人身上的秘密，你决定……
dialog2dText.en:
You finish the repairs and the Delta Bot starts moving, trembling and seemingly confused. It projects a confused emote. 
The unit then stands silently beside the other trashed units, as though it is trying to remember something. 
To investigate the secrets of the Delta Bots, you decide to...

dialog2dTitle.cn: 坏在同伴中间的机器人

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近四年的机器人，主要从事长途运输工作。
数据比想象中少得多，几乎没有什么信息被储存下来。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly four years, and mainly carried out long-distance hauls.
To your surprise, there is barely any data.

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人长期被投放在一处杳无人烟的边缘区域，承担相关的运输任务。
由于当地地形复杂，部署在附近的机器人都有着极高的折损率，它似乎是四年以来同机型里唯一的幸存者。
日志末尾有一些意义不明的字词组合：同伴 同伴 同伴 同伴 同伴 梦 永远
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, this unit has been deployed in a barely inhabited area to carry out various transport jobs. 
Due to the complicated terrain, the local fleet of Delta Bots has suffered extremely high rates of accidental losses. This unit seems to be the only survivor of the fleet throughout these four years. 
The log ends with a mysterious text string: "Friend. Friend. Friend. Friend. Friend. Dream. Forever."

dialog2dText.cn: 你隐约觉得Delta型机器人的诡异行动应该和数据与日志里的记录有关，但想要进一步探究，显然还需要更多线索。
dialog2dText.en: You are starting to see a link between the Delta Bot's abnormal behavior and its data logs. However, you obviously need more intel to further your investigation.

dialog2dText.cn:
经过你的努力，Delta型机器人再次启动，身上的花瓣纷纷扬扬地落下，如同迎来了一场新生。
它向你投影了一个微笑的表情，接着主动凑了过来，像是知道你的目的。
于是，为了探寻这些Delta型机器人身上的秘密，你最终决定……
dialog2dText.en:
You complete the repairs. The Delta Bot reactivates itself as the petals on it fall off, as though it has gained a new life. 
It projects a Smiley emote and takes a few steps towards you as though it knows your objective. 
To unravel the secrets of these Delta Bots, you finally decide to...

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近十年的机器人，从事过长短途运输工作，也从事过物资储存工作。
这几乎是你见过的数据量最大的机器人，甚至让人不免为它拥有的存储能力而惊叹。
但最让你惊讶的是，有一部分数据和你最开始备份的那份“通行证”数据完全一致，仔细探查后你发现，这个机器人记录了所有机器人的“通行证”数据。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly ten years, and carried out inventory and storage jobs. 
This unit has the most log entries you have ever seen, making you wonder if the unit's storage is large enough for everything. 
Most surprisingly, some of the data is an exact copy of the "Access Pass" data log backed up from the first unit you repaired. Upon closer inspection, you realize that the unit has recorded all "Access Pass" data entries of every unit.

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人的工作经历堪称传奇，几乎在武陵的每个地方都工作过。
但就在它完成第十年的最后一件工作后，它似乎进入了整整一年的故障期，日志上显示它拒绝接受所有的工作指令，只是反复播放一个地点的画面，但记录者并不清楚画面的所在地。
之后，它在某一天突然失踪，日志结束。
最后是一段依然难以解读的字词组合：梦 目的地 休息 永远 同伴
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, this unit has an almost legendary list of jobs that covers almost every place in Wuling. 
However, after completing its last job in its tenth year of service, it entered a state of malfunction that lasted an entire year. Log entries reveal that it has rejected all job commands. Instead, it kept projecting a photo of an unknown location. 
In the end, the unit went missing and it stopped logging data entirely. 
The log also ends with a mysterious text string: "Dream. Destination. Rest. Forever. Friend."

dialog2dText.cn:
在收集到了所有的线索后，你觉得你已经明白了机器人们行为背后的真相。
望向此刻还在苦思冥想的纪耘，你决定告诉他你的答案。
dialog2dText.en:
Having collected all the clues, you believe you have understood the robots' behavior. 
Ji Yun still looks very confused. You decide to share your answers with him.

dialog2dText.cn:
Delta型机器人重新站了起来，头顶象征“故障”的标识却并未消失。
它努力想要移动自己，却始终无果。
你思考了一下，决定……
dialog2dText.en:
The Delta Bot is back on its legs but it is still displaying the "Damaged" indicator icon. 
It tries to move itself but to no avail.
After giving it some thought, you decide to...

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近七年的机器人，主要从事短途运输工作。
除了大量的路线数据，只有一份名为“通行证”的数据记录——备注是“目的地”。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly seven years, and mainly carried out short-distance delivery jobs.
In addition to large amounts of route-planning data, there is a data log titled "Access Pass" furnished with the note: "Destination".

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人的工作范围十分广泛，几乎去过武陵的每个角落。
但最近的行动路线全围绕在这一地带，附近疑似有它的“驻扎地”。
日志末尾有一些意义不明的字词组合：休息 最后 寻找 梦 帮助 目的地
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, the unit has been assigned all sorts of jobs and has visited nearly every place in Wuling. However, its recent trips revolve around the local area, suggesting the existence of a "camp". 
The log ends with a mysterious text string: "Rest. Final. Seek. Dream. Help. Destination."

dialog2dText.cn: 为了帮纪耘找出机器人失踪的真相，你尝试搜索“目的地”的线索，但就在这时，无法移动的机器人忽然动了起来，启动了一旁的弹射装置——如同在尝试开拓一条全新的通路……
dialog2dText.en: To help Ji Yun investigate the truth behind the missing robots, you try searching for clues on the "Destination". The immobile Delta Bot suddenly begins to move and activates a bounce device nearby, as though it is trying to create an all-new path...

dialog2dText.cn:
经过你的努力，Delta型机器人像是获得了某种能量，终于正常启动了，连投影也比刚刚亮了不少。
它不断投影出友善的表情，似乎是在向你表达感谢。
但很快你就发现，它没有像往常那些机器人一样，在恢复行动能力后回到常规工作状态，而是留在原地转起了圈，如同在玩某种游戏。
回想起最开始遇到的那个Delta型机器人，你意识到还需要收集更多的信息，才能厘清其中的真相。
于是你决定……
dialog2dText.en:
After your hard work, the Delta Bot's hologram brightens up and resumes normal operations as though it has regained some energy. 
The unit is constantly projecting Thank You emotes as though it is conveying its gratitude. 
You quickly notice that the unit has not reverted to normal task routines like the other Deltas. Instead, it is running around in circles as though it is playing a game. 
You think about the first Delta Bot you encountered and realize you need more information to arrive at the truth. 
Hence, you decide to...

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近五年的机器人，主要从事长途运输工作。
数据中还存在大量冗余的记录，明显与追加了过多额外工作有关。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly five years, and mainly carried out long-distance hauls.
The data has numerous redundant entries that are obviously linked to the excessive number of tasks assigned to it.

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人每日平均工作时长严重超过正常标准，所属机构已被相关部门警告过三次。
它的使用者似乎十分缺乏任务规划的常识，经常在它工作的时候追加新的运输任务，让它的工作时间被无休止地拉长。
日志末尾有一些意义不明的字词组合：休息 休息 休息 梦 梦 最后
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, the average daily work load of this unit far exceeds standard limits. The organization managing this unit has been given three warnings. 
Its user seems oblivious to standard work assignment protocols, and has repeatedly added new transport jobs during its trips, resulting in endless extensions of its operational hours. 
The log ends with a mysterious text string: "Rest. Rest. Rest. Dream. Dream. Final."

dialog2dText.cn:
你隐约觉得Delta型机器人的诡异行动应该和数据与日志里的记录有关，但为了能进一步探究，显然还需要更多线索。
慎重考虑后，你决定联系菲奥娜，让她帮你将收集到的信息整合起来，方便之后对比。
dialog2dText.en:
You are starting to see a link between the Delta Bot's abnormal behavior and its data logs. However, you obviously need more intel to further your investigation. 
After careful consideration, you decide to call Fiona and ask her to help you organize various findings for comparative analysis.

dialog2dText.cn:
经过你的修理，内置的自洁模块重新运行，Delta型机器人身上的锈蚀大部分都被清除了，看起来焕然一新。
它向你走了几步，投影了一个感谢的表情，然后又慢吞吞地回到了伞下，仿佛那里才是让它安心的场所。
而为了探寻这些Delta型机器人身上的秘密，你决定……
dialog2dText.en:
Your repairs re-activate the onboard self-cleaning module of the Delta Bot that successfully removes most of its rust and makes it look new again. 
The Delta Bot takes a few steps towards you, projects a Thank You emote, and slowly waddles back to the umbrella that it probably treats as its safe spot. 
To investigate the secrets of the Delta Bots, you decide to...

dialog2dText.cn:
运行数据显示——这是一个运行时间近八年的机器人，主要从事物资储存工作。
数据大多受到了侵蚀的影响，几乎难以提取。
dialog2dText.en:
According to the operational log, this unit has been in service for nearly eight years, and mainly carried out inventory and storage jobs.
Most data entries have been corrupted by the Blight and are barely accessible.

dialog2dText.cn:
工作日志显示——这个机器人曾长时间被投放在侵蚀潮附近的区域，但并未得到过有效的防护。
目前无法确认是否为相关负责人的疏忽，但显而易见的是，距离它上一次的检修已经过去了五年。
日志末尾有一些意义不明的字词组合：休息 雨 雨 雨 停止 梦
dialog2dText.en:
According to the work log, this unit has been deployed close to the Blight Tide without adequate protection. 
Currently, there is no way of telling if this was due to the user's actual oversight. One thing is obvious. The unit's most recent repair log is dated to five years ago. 
The log ends with a mysterious text string: "Rest. Rain. Rain. Rain. Stop. Dream."

dialog2dText.cn: 你隐约觉得Delta型机器人的诡异行动应该和数据与日志里的记录有关，但想要进一步探究，显然还需要更多线索。
dialog2dText.en: You are starting to see a link between the Delta Bot's abnormal behavior and its data logs. However, you obviously need more intel to further your investigation.
